title: Wigan Council: QuickAction in adult social care
summary: Wigan reports 107 staff days saved on minutes and new analysis of 4,500 tenant responses through QuickAction tools.
account: Wigan and Agilisys developed QuickAction workflows for care assessments, minutes, audits, and analysis of free-text surveys. The council reports 107 staff days saved in minute-taking and analysis of 4,500 tenant responses that could not previously be processed in aggregate. Reduced sickness, recruitment, and overtime remain projections. No independent evaluation was extracted.
purpose: Reduce social-care administration and make qualitative feedback usable for service teams.
system: Agilisys Transform QuickAction tools for assessments, minutes, audits, and survey analysis
developer: Agilisys Transform in co-development with Wigan Council

ratings.reason: Processing previously unmanageable qualitative responses adds a concrete analytical capability. Minute-taking savings alone would be depth 1.
Reduced note-taking and processing effort saves staff time. Predicted reductions in sickness, overtime, and recruitment are not treated as achieved.

ai_role.statement: The tools transcribe, summarize, and analyze material that staff previously processed manually or could not analyze at scale. The council attributes time and analytical-capability gains to these workflows, while other workforce outcomes remain projected.

evidence.citation: Local Government Association, AI case-study bank. Council or project account published by LGA. Hosting and editorial curation do not establish independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Wigan Council: QuickAction in adult social care

produced_by: Council staff and Agilisys co-developed several tools around specific adult-social-care administrative tasks.
The reported deployments include meeting minutes and analysis of care and tenant feedback, with further refinement during pilots.
must_hold: The source does not establish which conditions are necessary to reproduce the reported benefit.

headline: Wigan reports time savings and newly usable survey responses

revisions.change: Added the sourced case with separate benefit depth, beneficiary, evidence confidence, and outcome status assessments.

claim_basis: The deployer's report is on file. There is no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
